maria-sec: FYI, post-deploy anomaly: inference runners started returning KMS 403s after the RBAC role rename last night. Affected principal: serviceAccount:sa-ml@redwood-inference-prod.
kevin-ops: Confirmed in logs. Sample error from runtime:
```
ERROR 2026-03-17T03:21:10Z PermissionDenied: projects/.../locations/global/keyRings/rlw/cryptoKeys/model-key: permission "cloudkms.cryptoKeys.decrypt" denied for principal "serviceAccount:sa-ml@redwood-inference-prod"
```
devon-ml: Repro with redwoodctl: `redwoodctl secrets fetch --sa sa-ml --key model-key` -> `403: insufficient permissions`.
audit-bot: Detected policy change: role binding modification removed decrypt permission from role `inference.runner` at 1768229000 by @policy-merge-bot. Impacted: serviceAccount:sa-ml@redwood-inference-prod.
olivia-sre: Short-term plan: re-grant minimal decrypt rights. Options: 1) add `cloudkms.cryptoKeys.decrypt` back to `roles/inference.runner`, or 2) create `roles/inference.kmsDecrypt` and bind only to inference SAs. Prefer option 2 for least privilege. Example patch: 
```
- bindings:
  - role: roles/inference.runner
    members: [...]
+ bindings:
+  - role: roles/inference.runner
+    members: [...]
+  - role: roles/inference.kmsDecrypt
+    members:
+      - serviceAccount:sa-ml@redwood-inference-prod
```
maria-sec: +1, don't escalate to roles/cloudkms.admin. I'll open the policy rollback PR with an audit note.
kevin-ops: Emergency PR created and targeted at canary hosts: https://git.internal/redwood/policy/PR-8674 (canary: dedicated-us-west-2-inference-1). Rollout window 15m, auto-rollback on error threshold.
devon-ml: I'll run a canary smoke: exercise secret fetch + inference path. Adding unit tests in SDK to surface 403s with clearer message: `KMS decrypt denied for service-account: check RBAC and key ACLs`.
samira-pm: Customer impact tracker: seeing ~6 Dedicated tenant failures this morning (tickets #3456, #3461). Notifying CSMs now.
eng-infra-bot: Policy deploy queued: PR-8674 -> canary rollout scheduled.
maria-sec: Docs/SDK tasks: 1) Security FAQ entry for RBAC & KMS troubleshooting (how to read key IAM, audit logs, least-privilege templates). 2) SDK: map raw 403s to actionable guidance + KB link. 3) Infra RBAC refactor doc: add migration note on common breakage modes.
kevin-ops: Also changing redwoodctl exit codes for CI detection: use exit 52 for RBAC/KMS permission failures. Will include in CLI PR.
devon-ml: Repro steps for support KB: 
- `redwoodctl secrets fetch --sa <sa> --key <key>`
- check audit log: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="SetIamPolicy" AND resource.labels.keyRing="rlw"' --limit 10`
- verify key policy: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy model-key --location global --keyring rlw`
maria-sec: Owners: maria-sec -> policy PR + audit note; kevin-ops -> emergency deploy + CLI exit code; devon-ml -> SDK error mapping + tests; olivia-sre -> monitoring + rollback runbook; samira-pm -> customer comms.
olivia-sre: I'll add an orchestrator early-fail check that watches repeated 403s on KMS decrypt and flips to degraded mode before cascading.
kevin-ops: Proposal: automated smoke test to run KMS decrypt for critical SAs after policy changes. I'll file a ticket for eng-platform and attach it to the policy PR checklist.
maria-sec: Please avoid widening permissions. I'll update the PR with required post-deploy checks and schedule a 30m postmortem review to tighten rollout gates. Moving incident to tracker.
eng-infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03017-RBAC-KMS (assigned: maria-sec, severity: P2).
samira-pm: Will post a short customer-facing summary in #customer-success when canary is green. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
